description: Phase 0 + Phase 1 (S1 audio, S2 AI) of .omc/plans/music-loop-game-plan.md. Gate decisions G1-G6 in plan §2. S3 CloudKit and real-device measurements need the user (Developer Program, devices) and are reported as stop points, not implemented here.

userStories.title: Phase 0: repo + LoopCore package + App target skeleton
acceptanceCriteria: git repo initialized at work/game with .gitignore excluding DerivedData, .build, generated *.xcodeproj, .omc/state
LoopCore/Package.swift (Swift Package, iOS 17 + macOS) with targets CAtomic (C) and LoopCore, test target LoopCoreTests using Swift Testing (import Testing)
`cd LoopCore && swift test` exits 0

project.yml (XcodeGen) defines iOS 17 App target depending on local LoopCore package; `xcodegen generate && xcodebuild build -scheme App -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=<from simctl>'` succeeds

userStories.title: S1 Clock: integer-rational tick->frame, hostTime->frame mapping, re-anchor
acceptanceCriteria: LoopCore/Sources/LoopCore/Clock.swift: frame(tick:sampleRate:bpm:) = floor(tick*sr*60/(bpm*480)) computed in Int64 integer arithmetic, no floating point, from absolute tick (no accumulation)
Test: for BPM 60/70/97/160 at 44100 and 48000, loop start frames over 10 minutes equal an independent oracle (exact rational via separate numerator/denominator computation) — zero mismatch
Test: no Int64 overflow for 10 min at BPM 160, sr 48000
hostTime->frame conversion from an anchor (hostTime, sampleTime) with mach timebase numer/denom, latency term L and user offset; unit tested with fixed timebase values
Re-anchor on sample-rate change 44.1k<->48k preserves musical tick position: tick position error <= 1 frame (test)

userStories.title: S1 RT-safe state swap: CAtomic shim + epoch reclamation
acceptanceCriteria: LoopCore/Sources/CAtomic: C11 stdatomic pointer load(acquire)/exchange(acq_rel) and epoch counter increment(release)/load(acquire)
Swift wrapper: main swaps RenderState via exchange, THEN reads epoch C; old state freed only when epoch >= C+2, or immediately if engine stopped
Test: after swap with epoch C+1 -> not freed; C+2 -> freed
Test reproducing order: render reads old pointer -> main exchange -> main reads C -> render callback end increments (C+1) -> old state NOT freed at this point
Test: engine-stopped swap frees immediately

userStories.title: S1 Renderer: allocation-free sample-accurate mixer, split vs one-shot bit-identical
acceptanceCriteria: Renderer.swift: immutable RenderState (preallocated UnsafeBufferPointer tracks/samples, tracks <= 8, bars {1,2,4,8}), render-thread-owned preallocated voice pool of 64; render path uses no Swift Array/class/closure/existential/allocation/lock
Test: 10 min, 8 tracks, BPM 60/70/97/160, render split into random buffer sizes 64..4096 is bit-identical to one-shot render
Test: every loop start in rendered output lands exactly on Clock integer-formula frame
Test: resampling a sample to a new rate yields length = original*newRate/oldRate +-1 frame

userStories.title: S1 App side: AudioHost + TouchPadView + latency/CPU measurement screen
acceptanceCriteria: App/AudioHost.swift: AVAudioEngine + AVAudioSourceNode calling LoopCore renderer, records (mHostTime, mSampleTime) anchor per callback, logs actual ioBufferDuration and outputLatency, re-anchors on AVAudioEngineConfigurationChange
App/SampleBank.swift: loads samples, resamples to engine rate (AVAudioConverter); placeholder synthesized test samples only (no third-party audio yet)
App/TouchPadView.swift: UIViewRepresentable passing UITouch.timestamp to AudioHost
Spike measurement screen: 500-tap in-app proxy latency (P50/P95/max), 8-track 60 s CPU average and underrun count, exportable log
App builds for iOS Simulator; simulator run of the measurement screen does not crash (device numbers are the user's step)

userStories.title: S2 Theory + Metrics (G3 definitions)
acceptanceCriteria: Theory.swift: major/minor scale masks, chord tones for C-G-Am-F etc, strong beat = beats 1 and 3

Metrics.swift: hard metrics (all pitched notes in scale, strong-beat notes are chord tones, note-count change <= 20%), statistical (grid error vs original ratio, onset F1 at 1/16 with pitch tolerance), drums use pitch-free metrics only
Unit tests for each metric with hand-made positive and negative cases

userStories.title: S2 corpus + licenses + training pipeline
acceptanceCriteria: licenses.json single list (allowed: CC0, CC-BY-4.0, self); test fails if any corpus/sample file lacks an entry
Drums: Groove MIDI Dataset (CC BY 4.0) subset converted; bass/chords/melody: self-authored patterns >= 100 per role, 1-8 bars, recorded as license self
tools/train/train.py (uv): pattern-level 80/20 split BEFORE jitter, builds per-role n-gram weights to LoopCore/Sources/LoopCore/Resources/model/*.json, each file <= 1 MB
Holdout eval set: holdout patterns x jitter (gaussian +-10..80 ms, 10% notes +-1..2 semitones, 5% drop/add) = 300 items, written to a fixture file

userStories.title: S2 Corrector B3b + runtime filter + go/no-go evaluation
acceptanceCriteria: Corrector.swift: B3b constrained beam search decoding positions and pitches from n-gram model (tokens: role, in-bar 16th position, scale-degree interval / drum pad), +-1/8 beat and +-2 semitone candidates masked by G3, note-count +-20% pruned inside beam; generates 3-5 candidates, filters with Metrics, returns top 1-2 by F1 or none

Eval harness (swift test or executable) reports on 300 holdout: hard metrics pass rate, statistical pass rate, mean F1 weak/strong, no-suggestion rate, ablation vs rule baseline (grid snap + nearest scale) with paired bootstrap 95% CI, model size, per-call latency on Mac

Go/no-go table written to .omc/reports/s2-ai.md against plan thresholds (hard 100%, stat >= 95% + mean F1 weak >= 0.85 strong >= 0.65, ablation CI lower bound > 0, no-suggestion <= 5%, model <= 1 MB); result reported honestly, thresholds not weakened

userStories.title: S1/S2 report + user stop points
acceptanceCriteria: .omc/reports/s1-audio.md: automated S1 go items (1)(2)(3') results with test output, and device items (3)(4) listed as user steps with exact instructions (iPhone 15 Pro / iPad Air 5, 50-tap loopback)
Recommender: fixed-order baseline implemented and tested; model evaluation marked blocked on user's >= 40 self-made songs (G6)
S3 CloudKit listed as blocked on Apple Developer Program
All work committed to git
